metaDescription: Order custom full zip outerwear for your team or event. Perfect for layering with easy branding. Get a quote today at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Full zip outerwear offers the convenience of easy on-and-off layering, making it a top pick for corporate uniforms, trade show giveaways, and employee rewards. Unlike pullovers, full zip styles let the wearer adjust ventilation without removing the garment, ideal for fluctuating indoor-outdoor conditions. Whether you choose a fleece vest like the Men's Rixford Polyfleece Jacket for mild weather or a rugged shell like the Carhartt Duck Vest for worksite durability, full zip construction provides a clean canvas for logo embroidery on the left chest or back. Your team stays comfortable while your brand stays visible.
